1. During the event, you can get Sparks through the following ways:
 · Complete the Fire Companion Codex quest.
 · Take part in the Continuing Sparks mode.
 · Check in at the Sparkelf statue in Horizon Square (only once per day).
 2. Continuing Sparks mode details:
 · Each day, interact with friends to light up Sparks. Interactions include:
 ※ Chat: send messages to each other.
 ※ Party Up: form a team.
 ※ Gift: send gifts to each other.
 ※ Aniimo Exchange: exchange Aniimo.
 ※ Visit Home: visit each other.
 · After you light up a Spark, a Spark icon will appear next to your friend’s nickname. The number next to it shows how many days you and that friend have interacted during the event. Once you hit 5 days or more, the Spark icon will also level up.
 · The Spark icon will gray out after the daily server refresh at 04:00. Interact with your friends to light it up again.
 3. Event rewards:
 · When your personal total number of Sparks reaches the required amount, you can claim personal progress rewards.
 · When the server-wide total number of Sparks reaches the required amount, all players can claim server-wide progress rewards.
 · Special Notes:
 ※ The Sparkelf with the <style=Hint_BgL>Sparkling Mutation</style> (including the Basic Form and Prismana Form) has a sparkling outline effect, but no partial recolor effect.
 ※ The Sparkelf (Prismana Form) will be unavailable after the event ends. Please stay tuned for future official announcements.
